doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Guitars Unlimited and the west coast sound
summary: Bucky identifies a west coast five-guitar record, likening Tommy Tedesco to Tony Mottola of the west coast.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I remember this kind of music from my parents’ house. I’m not sure you’re on this but it wouldn’t surprise me.
Okay well why do you know that?

Well we know when certain things come out where they’re from you know. They made a couple of records out there with five guitars. It was a rarity to have someone do that. That was the west coast. Who was that by the way?
I think it was Tommy Tedesco maybe.
It was actually tough music to play and the woodwinds are going [scats].
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Tedesco is the Tony Mottola of the west coast.
